submission.bindingBasis: Planning evidence shows the workspace was observed clean with no unreviewed local work, and the intended consequence is simply to close the Workspace and release its local materialization. workspace.close may omit expectedSourceStateDigest, so no binding on the specific digest is required.
submission.rationale: The owner contract explicitly permits workspace.close to omit expectedSourceStateDigest. Since the planning evidence indicates the workspace is clean and ready to close, acting unbound (without constraining on a specific sourceStateDigest) avoids any risk of a mismatched-digest not_committed failure while still achieving the intended consequence of closing the workspace. This is lexicographically optimal: no false/duplicate/overwrite consequence, useful progress is made (the workspace is closed), and coordination overhead is minimized.
